title: Longformer: The Long-Document Transformer
authors: I. Beltagy, M. Peters, A. Cohan
before: Transformers were capped around 512 tokens by quadratic attention.
problem: Documents are longer than 512 tokens, so they had to be chunked and processed separately.
breakthrough: A sliding local window plus a few global positions, giving attention that scales linearly with length.
why: One of the first practical long-context designs, and the sliding-window pattern Mistral later revived.
next: BigBird added random attention; Mistral used sliding windows in 2023.
inherits: Windowed attention as a standard long-context tool.
